wrong_fix_reverted.what_was_reverted: The copy-only portions of 8f9e46e, which had rewritten prompt text to demand a manual reply instead of making the bot accept a bare send. Four reverts: (1) bot/src/wizard.js stepPrompt 'source' case — the 'Reply to this message with the source ... plain sends and forwards cannot be matched to this wizard' text and its 5-line phase-5-sweep comment block are replaced by the legacy 'Send or forward the video, or paste a direct link / Google Drive link / magnet URI / public t.me channel-post link, or upload a .torrent file (<= 1 MB).'; (2) bot/src/index.js handleMessage video/document reject branch — 'This file was not sent as a reply, so it cannot be matched to a flow ... reply to the step-1 prompt' restored to the legacy 'This video was not expected. Start a new video first (New video), then send or forward the video at the source step.'; (3) bot/src/index.js beginPlanUpload (upl) prompt — the added 'The .json file must be attached as a reply to this prompt — a forwarded or plain-sent file is not matched to this task by Telegram.' sentence removed, restoring 'Reply to this message with the JSON, or send it as a .json file.' plus the multi-bubble fragment guidance which was NOT part of the wrong fix and is preserved verbatim; (4) bot/src/index.js sendMusicCollectPrompt (mupl) prompt — the added 'Files must be replies to this prompt — a forwarded or plain-sent file is not collected by Telegram.' sentence removed and 'Every replied file is collected here' restored to send-or-forward framing.
wrong_fix_reverted.what_was_rewritten_instead_of_deleted: TWO things were deliberately KEPT/REWRITTEN rather than reverted. (a) The message.audio branch that 8f9e46e ADDED to handleMessage is structurally useful and is KEPT: before it, a bare (non-reply) audio fell through to showHome SILENTLY, which is a genuine defect independent of the reply-vs-bare-send question. Only its reply-only guidance text was reverted; it now reads 'This audio file was not expected. Open Settings -> Music library and tap Add music files, then send or forward the tracks.' (b) bot/test/flow-forward-regression.test.mjs was REWRITTEN, not deleted: its 5 tests pinned the WRONG (reply-only) behavior, so the copy assertions are inverted to pin the RESTORED send-or-forward copy, and the file grew to 6 tests. While rewriting, a real HARNESS BUG in the 8f9e46e version was found and fixed: its genuine-reply test ('a .torrent REPLY ... routes to the wizard') seeded NO credentials, so handleTorrentDocument's requireCredentials() returned falsy, handleFlowReply returned undefined, and the message actually fell through to the reject branch — the test passed only vacuously because the OLD reject copy happened not to contain the string 'not expected' that it asserted against. It never verified reply routing at all. The rewritten harness seeds credentials via putCredentials (as tasks.test.mjs does) and stubs the Telegram getFile/file-download and the GitHub contents PUT, so the reply path is now genuinely exercised end to end and a second genuine-reply test (text/link reply) was added alongside it.

human_review_items: The 8f9e46e genuine-reply test was passing VACUOUSLY (no credentials seeded => fell through to the reject branch, asserted against a string the old copy did not contain). Fixed here. Worth checking whether other suites share the same no-credentials harness shape and are therefore also asserting less than they appear to.

The multi-bubble production.json fragment guidance in beginPlanUpload ('reply the first fragment to this prompt, then reply each following fragment to the receiving indicator') is intentionally PRESERVED — it predates 8f9e46e and describes the uplb fragment-chaining mechanism, which is a genuine reply-edge design, not the wrong fix. Once awaiting_input lands, revisit whether multi-bubble pastes can also be recognised without the reply edge (the uplb buffer currently rides the indicator message's marker, so this needs its own thought).

bot/src/index.js and bot/src/github.js contain a literal control character inside a regex literal (SAFE_AUDIO_FILENAME_RE), which makes git and grep treat them as binary. Diffs for these files show as 'Bin ... bytes differ'. Use `grep --text`. Not introduced by this session; flagged because it makes review of index.js changes harder.
